This is a small table made from real LDraw parts: a red 4×6 plate (3032) for the top, resting on four legs. Each leg is two white 1×1 bricks (3005) stacked. I assumed LDraw's native coordinates, where negative y points up and each part's origin sits at its top face, and that the 4×6 plate's long side runs along x. I haven't confirmed how the viewer interprets either, so the table may render upside down or turned 90° if it follows a different convention. The parts list is switched on so you can see the cost estimate.
